versions.content: Memory stack shall be able to handle program flash device(s) Type: draft Description: The memory stack shall be able handle the program flash. Rationale: The memory stack must write (flash) new program data into the expected program flash sections. Dependencies: Use Case: In order to realize the FOTA procedure, the program flash sections must be accessible by the related driver for writing (and reading). Supporting Material:
